Anonymous post for another group member
*How to start the process when we both don’t have a stable home?*

My Israeli partner and I plan to start the couples visa process within the next year, but first want to travel the world together for a year+ while conditions are ideal (both remote, before kids, process not yet started).

There are two ways to begin:

*1. From Israel:* He returns to Israel and starts the process there. From what I understand, I can't enter as a tourist once the process has begun, and may only be allowed in after the interviews, which could take up to a year. Can he leave Israel for extended periods during this time so we can still live abroad together, or is there a minimum stay requirement?

*2. From Abroad:* We apply at an embassy outside of Israel, complete the interviews there, and enter Israel together once I have my visa. A few open questions: Which embassy do we use, mine or his second nationality? Does it matter that we haven't officially lived together in either country due to constant travel? How long would we need to be based in one place before applying?

We have never rented a long-term apartment together, but we have a ton of pictures, flight tickets, tourist visas, airbnbs… 

Any experience or insight welcome! 🙏
